'''Drokka''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who worked as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. He also worked for [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]], as a sales rep.

==Biography==
He was sent by Merr-Sonn to represent the company at the [[Cularin Trade Show]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and he exhibited the [[G-8 power blaster]] there. He pointed out to customers the tactical advantages that the rifle had and claim that it was a more accurate ranged weapon than similar rifles being exhibited at the show by rival companies.<ref name="FFAP">{{LivingForce|For Fun and Profit}}</ref>

Drokka later cooperated with the bounty hunters [[Shiana Trist]] and [[K1-1R]] to collect [[Contract AA23 (roleplaying adventure)|Contract AA-23]], a bounty that had been placed on the [[Heroes of Cularin]].<ref name="CAA23">{{LivingForce|Contract AA23 (roleplaying adventure)}}</ref>
